headline: Not US and IMF, Here's the Biggest Debt Supplier to RI
summary: Indonesia's external debt from various countries and global institutions mostly rose at the end of the third quarter of 2026. The article identifies the largest creditors.
why: External debt levels affect Indonesia's fiscal sustainability and currency exposure, which matter to bond and currency investors.
original_headline: Bukan AS dan IMF, Ini Dia Si Pemasok Utang Terbesar ke RI
